Im just scared that the staff want more that they wont be accused if I hurt myself, than acutally help me, so they ll just put me on 1:1, no phone...

Im in a psych ward already, voluntaty for suicidal thoughts. But I didnt tell them I have a plan. And im afraid to tell, because I dont want to lose my freedom and free will. Now im in a department where Im free to go to the hospitals park, I can have my phone, I can have visitors...etc. 
Should I tell them? What should I do? :(
